Product Details: Makita has created a new class in wireless with LXT® 18V subcompact tools. Makita® Sub-Compact products offer users 12V handling with 18V performance and compatibility with the world's largest 18V cordless tool system. The CX205RB is a combo kit with two 18V subcompact solutions for drilling, driving and fixing in tight spaces.The kit includes an ultra-compact brushless hammer drill and impact driver. Hammer percussive adjustment allows drilling into masonry and brick. It has two speed settings and a metal jampot design for durability. It offers 350 inches. peak torque, speeds up to 1,700 rpm and 25,500 BPM for a wide range of applications. The variable speed brushless impact driver has two speed settings and offers 3 cm. Max. torque It has an assist mode (A mode), which helps eliminate "cam-out screws" and "cross threading" by driving at low speeds until tightening begins.It is part of Makita's 18V LXT expandable system, the world's largest cordless tool system powered by 18V lithium-ion batteries. Makita® 18V LXT lithium-ion batteries have the fastest charging times in their class, so they spend more time working and less time sitting on the charger.For better tool performance and extended battery life, Makita created Star Protection Computer Controls™. Star Protection is a communication technology that allows the tool and battery equipped with Star Protection to exchange data in real time and monitor conditions during use to protect against overcharging, over-discharge and overheating. For added versatility, the tool can also be powered by Makita 18V LXT lithium-ion batteries with the star symbol on the battery indicating protection of the stars inside.
